components.name: Studio UI
components.description: General availability of the GraphOS Studio user interface unrelated to specific sub-sections

components.name: Schema Proposals
components.description: Workflows and services which directly impact the Schema Proposals experience.

components.name: Transactional Emails
components.description: Emails sent as part of GraphOS operations (proposals, password resets, etc.)

components.name: Insights Dashboard
components.description: The features of Apollo Studio that power viewing usage of your graph. This includes the fields page, clients page, operations page, and certain screens within other main tabs of the Studio application.

components.name: GraphQL API
components.description: The API that supports reading metrics, schemas, client metadata, publishing and validating schemas.

components.name: Installer CDN
components.description: CDN which serves Rover CLI and Router runtime binaries

components.name: Homepage, Documentation and Blogs
components.description: This includes the homepage (www.apollographql.com), docs content, and blog content.

components.name: Uplink
components.description: GraphOS Managed Supergraph Delivery. Apollo Router and Apollo Gateway use Uplink to fetch supergraphs from the Apollo registry.

components.name: Metrics Ingestion
components.description: The metrics ingestion pipeline that deployed Apollo Router and Apollo Server instances transmit to.  These enable support of Studio analytics and other features.

components.name: Schema Publishing
components.description: The Schema Publishing feature which is leveraged by tools like Server auto-reporting, `rover graph publish`, and `rover subgraph publish`.

components.name: Notifications
components.description: This includes features like Slack, Webhooks, and Emails.

components.name: Schema Checks
components.description: The Schema Checks feature enabling user workflows for commands like `rover graph check`, and `rover subgraph check`.

components.name: Datadog Forwarding
components.description: A feature of Apollo Studio that allows users to forward metrics observed via Apollo's telemetry pipeline to their Datadog instance(s).

incident_updates.body: Starting at 17:00 Pacific / 00:00 UTC on 2026-07-29 (30th UTC), we are upgrading our metrics database. Metric and trace ingestion will be delayed during the update, which is anticipated to take up to 30 minutes. Any operation checks that run may not check against any new operation shapes from after 17:00 Pacific / 00:00 UTC. Insights pages and performance alerts may also not work as expected during this migration. All metrics and traces will become available after the migration completes.
